pages.title: Traditionalists
pages.text: The $(l)Traditionalists$() are the Federation bloc that keeps the old Charter ways. Brass. Steam. Iron. Wax seals. Written letters. Audited books.$(br2)They are led, informally, by $(l)Yoki Stilts$() of the high ridges.

Traditionalists are not against magic. They are against the Charter signing dockets it cannot $(o)audit$(). Source flow is hard to measure. Spell-craft is harder. A Charter clerk cannot weigh a soul-stone the way they weigh an ingot.$(br2)The Traditionalist position is: if you cannot audit it, do not sign for it.

In practice, Traditionalist colonies run cleaner books, slower forges, and tighter walls. They lose fewer audits. They also lose more Federation contracts to the Reformers, who can produce healing potions on tap.
